summary: Turn 24, final turn of the run's time budget. Submitted a scoped stop (action=stop, scope=candidate, reason=resource_limit) releasing local work on the quorum-arithmetic Candidate 0922502bc12a4af68ee74cb77942fd72, with ref_ids pointing at that candidate, F-DECISION, the S-QUORUM-SIZES material, B-PREPARE-REPLY-LEADER and B-COMMIT. The rationale records exactly what is grounded and what is not: for even N the two quorum formulas stop describing intersecting sets and a majority (N=4 gives FastQuorumSize 2 and SlowQuorumSize 2), no captured file validates that N is odd (run.go:30 computes f = (N-1)/2 with no parity check), and handlePrepareReply rebuilds once it has SlowQuorumSize replies including its own (epaxos/epaxos.go:1210-1218); the conflicting-recovery hazard was narrowed to a precondition — a replica that reached the instance without recording its Commit — because handleCommit records COMMITTED for every receiver and startRecoveryForInstance returns early for a COMMITTED instance with commands (epaxos/epaxos.go:1127-1135) while bcastCommit skips non-Alive peers; that precondition belongs to membership/liveness (A4), which was never read, so it is released rather than escalated into an invented obligation. The stop is explicitly scoped to one candidate, not the run, and asserts neither that even N is deployable nor that the hazard occurs. Resume conditions enumerate the concrete next reads (A4 membership/Alive/reconnect handling, external N-parity enforcement, and the restart-with-NOOP branch together with the Accept majority requirement for N=4). The feedback restates the same boundary. Run state at handoff: one confirmed violation (CLM-DURABLE-BAL, outcome violated, confirmed true, no blockers — recordInstanceMetadata writes vbal into the bal slot and never persists bal), four candidates explained (inert TryPreAccept defer-cycle guard, unreachable handleCommit nil-lb branch, Accept-reply escalation bounded by the recovery timer, client positional reply pairing safe for the modelled client), map at audit_spec_version 6 with F-DURABLE-META corrected, and the remaining frontier recorded: A1 fast path and A2 authority transitions never exercised, A4 membership unread, A6 consequence of the confirmed durability defect undemonstrated. Preflight validation returns valid=true.
